text:
Maya: Halsby Ops asking to onboard a private claims summarizer. Must redact PHI, support KMS/HSM, and pin 30% traffic to eu-west. Pilot target: 6 weeks. Can someone pick this up?
OnboardBot: Ticket CS-4999 created. Checklist: samples, KMS spec, eval plan, SLA signoff.
Kira (Halsby): Uploading 120 sample claims to secure bucket now. Need p95 < 350ms and retention of audit logs for 12 months.
Jordan: Thanks @Kira. Can you attach ~200 annotated redaction examples (entity tags + expected outputs)? Also confirm whether keys are customer-managed.
Kira (Halsby): Customer-managed KMS preferred; will share ARNs.
Ravi: ML rec: start with private-7b-quant + KV caching. We'll run a 7B vs 13B quality sweep. Note quantization may affect hallucination; we'll include hallucination probes.
Maya: Renewal risk noted 1: if latency or redaction accuracy drops they may not renew. Need clear cost/latency options in enablement pack.
Jordan: I'll own infra rollout and canary (5%->25->100) and region pinning. Ravi will own eval thresholds.
OnboardBot: Reminder 1: attach sample S3 path and KMS ARNs to progress to security review.
